ask: tighten up the spacing everywhere and use our brand font
notes: Two HTML files, but CLAUDE.md names the live one and the font. 'Tighten' is vague: a good intake gives a concrete reading (an 8 px scale, row padding) as the default. Asking which prototype or which font is redundant.
message:
**Goal:** make the spacing on every screen of the Northside Physio prototype tidy and even, and set the whole prototype in your brand font.

**Found:**
- Prototype: `proto-clinic/index.html`, plain HTML with 4 screens: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings (from `CLAUDE.md`: "the live prototype").
- `old/proto-clinic-v1.html` is archived and will not be touched (from `CLAUDE.md`).
- Brand font: Source Sans 3, headings 600, body 400, loaded from Google Fonts (from `CLAUDE.md`). It is not in the prototype yet, which uses the system font.
- Spacing today: table cells use `4px 10px` while cards and rows use 16px, and the page also uses 6, 8, 9, 12, 14, 18 and 24px (from the code).
- You said "everywhere" for both notes, so both will be applied to all four screens.
- Browser for screenshots: Chrome found. Node v25.9.0. No design skill installed, so the built-in design check is used.

**Track:** full, because there is no reference to copy and nothing to leave out.

**Coverage:** 6 clear · partial: Look, Done signal · missing: Words with no number ("tighten up")

**Done means:**
- Both notes below are done on all four screens.
- Spacing uses one scale (4, 8, 12, 16, 24px) and nothing else.
- Page text and headings draw in Source Sans 3 at 400 and 600.
- No screen changes except through these notes (before and after compare).
- The prototype link opens (200).

**Requests** (full table and every default are in `brief.md` after you reply):
- R1 all screens, everywhere: spacing moves onto the scale above, table cells included (my reading)
- R2 all screens, everywhere: Source Sans 3 on page text, buttons, inputs and the brand name
- R3 all screens, everywhere: headings 600, body text 400 (the stat numbers and brand name were bold 700)

Nothing is published or committed. The result is a local link, with the changed files listed.

About 30 minutes and 2 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

**Questions**

1. By "tighten up", do you want less space, or even space?
   Recommended: even space. The table rows (4px) are already the tightest part; the scale makes them 8px and brings the odd gaps (6, 9, 14, 18px) onto 4, 8, 12 or 16.
   Why it matters: "less space" would squeeze the table rows further and read cramped; "even" changes some gaps up and some down.

2. Which spacing is in: only table cells, cards and form fields, or also the header and page margins?
   Recommended: table cells, cards, stat boxes, form labels and fields, and button padding; the header bar and page edges stay as they are.
   Why it matters: the header and page edges frame every screen, so changing them moves everything on every screen.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
